mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ingredient_expiry WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY expiry_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ingredient_expiry (user_id, name, purchase_date, expiry_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{purchaseDate}, #{expiryDate})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ingredient_expiry WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ingredient_expiry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND expiry_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND notified = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ingredient_expiry SET notified = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
